messages:
Ravi (partnerships): Quick pulse: US marketplace wants final SKU names + checksum by EOD PT. We also heard a late thermal note on Gaudi from the vendor.

Elena (marketplace): Deadline noted. Names must use hyphens only, no uppercase. Also need a short description (<=120 chars).

Tom (eng-infra): Build pipeline can append checksum and sig. Will need vendor-provided firmware baseline.

Gaudi_PM: Thermal note: on sustained 95% util some boards hit a derate window. Mitigation = reduce sustained clock 4% + adjust fan curve. OEM is ok with this if we include note in release.

MetaVendor_ops: We'll push the signed image by tomorrow AM PST and include the checksum. Can we get the marketplace name constraint doc?

Elena (marketplace): Pasting naming rules: use lower-case, dashes, max 32 chars. example: gaudi-dedicated-eu. Also include data residency line.

Ravi (partnerships): Decision path for announce: green = all artifacts + checksums in 72h -> announce global; amber = image stagger -> announce with phased regions; red = firmware blocker -> hold.

announce-bot: Reminder scheduled: upload-checksums task -> due in 36h.

Tom (eng-infra): Action items: (1) vendor upload image+checksum by 2026-04-04 12:00 UTC, (2) infra sign and publish checksums, (3) marketplace confirm naming. I'll add runbook snippet for SI.

Ravi (partnerships): Thanks — reconvene 24h. Ping me for blockers. :white_check_mark:
